notes: kb/Work PB5213 landed. The format is {PICTURE | PIC} IS character-string (§1985:VI.5.9.2), IS optional and written once. PICMODE no longer skips every IS: the first IS after PIC/PICTURE is the IS token pictureClause takes (PIC IS? PIC_STRING), and a second IS is the character-string (CobolLexer.OnPictureIs types it PIC_STRING and ends the mode), which the PICTURE rules refuse (COBOL0808, I is no symbol; §1985:VI.5.9.3 SR2). Probed at --std 85: '01 B PIC IS IS.' is COBOL0808 'invalid PICTURE symbol I in PICTURE IS'; '01 A PIC IS IS IS X(4)' is refused (COBOL5506 near X); PICTURE IS on one line with the string on the next, PIC IS X and PIC X run. The other probes of the read and the refuter held (semicolon separator, continued character-string, edited and currency strings; PICTURE PIC X COBOL0808, PIC. COBOL5506, PIC twice COBOL2423).

next.reason: §1985:VI.5.9.2 is '{PICTURE|PIC} IS character-string' alone. §2023:13.18.40.2 keeps that as the base of 'Format 1 (basic)' but adds the optional, repeatable 'EDITING character-1 FOR' NEGATIVE/POSITIVE phrase and a 'Format 2 (locale)' with LOCALE and SIZE, both refused by the 1985 format; a 1985 PICTURE clause means the same, but the format is wider, so CHANGED. PIC as an abbreviation is the 1985 rule §1985:VI.5.9.3 SR6, whose own 2023 counterpart is §2023:13.18.40.3 SR5, so it is not part of this record.
